name: list_kinds
description: List kinds of thing in the world, each with its identifier, a one-line summary, how many live individuals it has with its specialisations, and how many of exactly its kind. By default only the kinds with individuals of their own are listed: what the world actually contains. Ask for 'present' to add the general kinds those specialise, or 'all' for the world model's whole vocabulary; narrow any listing with 'within'. To find the candidates of a kind you already know, search it with find_individuals instead.

within.description: A kind's identifier, or its plain name when no other kind shares it; only that kind and its specialisations are listed.

listing.description: Which kinds to list: 'instantiated', those with individuals of their own; 'present', those with individuals of their own or of a specialisation; 'all', every kind.
